多個縮寫以逗號分隔，每個最多32字、最多8個。留空可移除。只保存在本機；縮寫只會: Separate up to 8 aliases with commas, up to 32 characters each. Leave empty to remove. Saved locally; only connected, loaded items can be found.

中文 App 名稱、檔名與已連接資料的標題可用拼音或注音搜尋，例如 honggu: Search Chinese app names, filenames and connected record titles using Pinyin or Zhuyin, such as hongguo / hg or ㄏㄨㄥˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ / ㄏㄍ. System transliteration may choose a different pronunciation for polyphonic characters; custom aliases can add alternatives.
右鍵點 App、檔案或個人資料結果，選「自訂搜尋縮寫…」。縮寫與項目識別資料只存: Right-click an app, file or personal result and choose Custom Search Aliases. Aliases and item identifiers stay on this Mac. Save an empty field to remove them. Calculator and task commands keep priority.
有 %@ 個資料夾尚無法恢復存取；已保留原有選擇，請重新選擇相同資料夾。: Access to %@ folders could not be restored. Previous selections were kept; select the same folders again.

全機內文使用系統索引；未索引、被排除、未下載或沒有權限的文件可能找不到。加入資料: System-wide contents use the macOS index. Unindexed, excluded, unavailable or inaccessible files may be missing. Add a folder for direct Chinese script matching and PPTX extraction; All still searches the system index. Legacy PPT depends on system indexing.

已搜尋全機文件索引與已連接資料。可縮短關鍵字，或加入資料夾補強尚未索引的文件；掃: Searched the system document index and connected sources. Try fewer keywords or add a folder for unindexed documents. Scanned PDFs still need OCR.
文件或搜尋輸出過大，請縮小搜尋範圍。: Document or search output is too large. Narrow the scope.

系統文件搜尋與原生 Spotlight 相同，也可能依檔名或中繼資料命中；直接讀: Like native Spotlight, system document search may also match filenames or metadata. Directly indexed folders show snippets around matching text.

已達摘要讀取上限；可開啟文件查看: Preview limit reached; open the document to view content
全機文件結果會在背景讀取顯示中的文件摘要，凸顯繁簡命中字；讀取失敗、沒有完整字詞: Visible system-index document results load excerpts in the background with cross-script highlights. Unavailable, non-literal or limited previews are labeled.
全機文件結果會在背景核對候選文件，優先顯示有完整字詞命中的摘要；其餘系統索引結果: Candidate documents are checked in the background. Literal content matches appear first; other system-index matches are collapsed by default.
正在核對文件內文，已確認的結果會先顯示…: Checking document content; confirmed matches appear first…

Custom aliases still work. Model names such as dl32 retain their digits; separate tonal Pinyin syllables, for example hong2 guo3.

預設關閉。補充結果受 macOS 系統索引與權限限制；不會把未選的文件加入 Ha: Off by default. Supplementary results depend on macOS indexing and permissions. Unselected documents are not added to the Han index.
尚未選擇文件資料夾；Han 不會自動掃描整個使用者資料夾。: No document folders selected. Han does not automatically scan your entire home folder.

索引含文件文字，僅保存在這台 Mac，不上傳，也不複製原始文件。預設略過 Lib: The index contains document text and stays on this Mac. No uploads or copies of original files. No OCR for scanned PDFs.
選擇要保存在本機搜尋索引的文件資料夾。只讀取支援的文字文件，不複製原始檔；可一次: Select document folders for the persistent local search index. Only supported document text is read; originals are not copied. You can select multiple folders.
文件資料夾授權無法恢復，請重新選擇；未顯示快取內文: Document folder access could not be restored. Reselect the folders; cached text is not shown.
正在更新 Han 文件索引；既有結果仍可搜尋…: Updating the Han document index; existing results remain searchable…

已搜尋 Han 收錄的文件與已連接資料；可增加搜尋資料夾。Spotlight 補: Searched Han-indexed documents and connected sources. Add more folders to expand coverage. Spotlight supplementation is optional in Settings; scanned PDFs require OCR.
Han 內文符合超過 200 筆，請增加關鍵字: More than 200 Han content matches; refine your query
文件頁數或讀取時間超過 Han 索引上限: Document pages or reading time exceed the Han index limit
以下原因分類僅統計前 200 份明細；未完成總數請見上方。: Reason counts below cover only the first 200 entries; see the total unfinished count above.
先在 Finder 下載並保留在本機，再更新索引。: Download and keep the file locally in Finder, then update the index.
掃描或圖片文件需要先做 OCR；空白文件沒有內文可索引。: Run OCR on scanned or image documents first. Blank documents have no text to index.
請先用密碼開啟 PDF，另存可讀取的副本，再更新索引。: Unlock the PDF and save a readable copy, then update the index.
可另存成 PPTX，或開啟 Spotlight 補充搜尋。: Save as PPTX, or enable supplementary Spotlight search.
可另存成 XLSX，或開啟 Spotlight 補充搜尋。: Save as XLSX, or enable supplementary Spotlight search.
可拆分成較小文件或匯出文字副本，再更新索引。: Split into smaller documents or export a text copy, then update the index.
請縮小資料夾範圍，或改用 Han 持久文件索引。: Choose a smaller folder scope, or use the persistent Han document index.
先確認原檔能正常開啟；若權限不足，重新選取資料夾；若檔案損壞，請修復或重新匯出。: Check that the original opens normally. Reselect the folder if access is denied; repair or re-export damaged files.
短時間內接續，逾時回到預設: Resume briefly, then return to default
上次搜尋僅在本次執行期間保留；重新啟動 App 會開啟空白的預設頁。未確認的新增: The previous search is kept for this app session only. Restarting opens a blank default page. Unconfirmed task drafts are preserved.
只在本機搜尋已授權資料；移除來源不會刪除原始內容。: Searches authorized data locally. Removing a source does not delete its original content.
右鍵點搜尋結果，即可自訂搜尋縮寫。拼音、注音與 App 首字母的用法請見使用說明: Right-click a result to add custom aliases. See the guide for Pinyin, Zhuyin and app initials.
常用結果會優先；學習紀錄只存在這台 Mac。: Frequently opened results rank higher. Learning history stays on this Mac.
從收起時開始計時；逾時後，下次開啟才清空搜尋並回到預設頁。正在輸入時不會被清除。: The timer starts when search is dismissed. After it expires, the next opening clears the query and returns to the default page. Active typing is never cleared.
讀取已選資料夾，索引只存在本機；移除索引不會刪除原始文件。: Indexes selected folders locally. Removing the index does not delete original documents.
在「一般」設定再次開啟時的行為與預設頁。可每次清空、一直保留，或在指定時間內接續: In General, choose your default page and whether to clear, keep or briefly resume searches. Retention starts when the panel is dismissed. Restarting the app does not restore the last query.
右鍵點搜尋結果可設定自訂縮寫。應用程式頁可以新增分類、拖動 App 到分類、修改: Right-click a result to add custom aliases. In Apps, create categories, drag apps into them, change category icons and reorder categories. Pinned and Recent offer additional entry points.
快速檔名清單用來找檔名與影片；Han 文件全文索引用來找文件內文。兩者需要各自選: The filename catalog finds files and videos by name. The Han full-text index searches document contents. Select folders for each; All combines their results.
Han 文件索引預設保存在 ~/Library/Application Supp: The document index is stored in ~/Library/Application Support/Spotlight Han/Index/. Extracted text stays locally and is not uploaded. The default capacity is 500 MB, adjustable in settings. The index has no additional encryption.
支援 Word、文字 PDF、PPTX、XLSX 與文字文件。預設略過 Libr: Supports Word, text PDFs, PPTX, XLSX and text documents. Skips Library, caches, hidden files and some development folders; does not follow symlinks. Limits: 20 MB per file, 8 MB extracted text, 100,000 ordinary files examined per pass.
背景更新啟用時，文件變更會觸發增量更新，另每 15 分鐘重新檢查。未變動的文件沿: With background updates enabled, file changes trigger incremental indexing, plus a recheck every 15 minutes. Unchanged documents reuse indexed text. Restarting does not require a full rebuild.
「讀取不完整」仍可搜尋成功讀取的文件。展開未完成明細查看處理建議：雲端檔先下載、: Partial reads still let you search successfully indexed documents. Expand failure details for remedies: download cloud files, run OCR on scans, convert older formats to PPTX/XLSX, or repair and re-export damaged documents.
移除搜尋範圍會清除對應的 Han 內文索引；清除並重建會重新擷取原檔。這些操作不: Removing a scope clears its Han full-text index. Rebuilding extracts the original documents again. Neither deletes originals. Supplementary Spotlight search is off by default and remains subject to system index limitations.
請到「資料來源」集中連接備忘錄、聯絡人、行事曆、提醒事項等。授權由 macOS: Connect Notes, Contacts, Calendar, Reminders and other apps in Data Sources. macOS manages permissions. Reload All updates connected sources only.
每次重新開啟時清空搜尋文字，並回到預設頁；正在使用的搜尋不受影響。: Each reopening clears the query and returns to the default page. An active search is unaffected.
重新開啟時接續上次的搜尋文字與頁面；預設頁只用於重新啟動 App。: Resume the previous query and page. The default page is used when restarting the app.
快捷鍵可開啟及收起面板。若要用 ⌘Space，先在系統設定 → 鍵盤 → 鍵盤快: The shortcut toggles search. To use ⌘Space, disable Show Spotlight search in System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > Spotlight. In Han, go to Search & Shortcuts and choose Use ⌘Space. Conflicts keep the previous shortcut.
請輸入至少 1 秒的有效時長；目前仍沿用上次設定。: Enter a valid duration of at least 1 second. Your previous setting is still in use.
一個搜尋框，找回你要的東西: One search box. Find what you need.
不用猜檔名是繁體還是簡體，也不用再翻好幾層資料夾。: Stop guessing which Chinese script a filename uses, or digging through folder after folder.
輸入「紅果短劇」，也能找到已安裝的「红果短剧」。: Type Traditional Chinese 紅果短劇 to find an installed app named 红果短剧 in Simplified Chinese.
選取資料夾後，可搜尋 Word、文字 PDF、PPTX、Excel 內文與命中片: Choose folders to search Word, text PDF, PPTX and Excel contents, with matching excerpts.
計算、每日匯率、翻譯，以及預覽後建立行程與提醒。: Calculate, convert currencies with daily rates, translate, and preview events or reminders before creating them.
首次不會自動掃描整個 Mac，也不會一次要求所有隱私權限。: Han does not automatically scan your entire Mac or ask for every privacy permission at startup.
預設保留上次搜尋 3 分鐘；你可以自訂時間及再次開啟的頁面。: Searches are kept for 3 minutes by default. Customize the duration and the page shown when reopening.
想用 ⌘Space，可在設定中直接前往 macOS 關閉原 Spotlight: To use ⌘Space, settings can take you to macOS to disable the original Spotlight shortcut before assigning it to Han.
先選常用資料夾即可。需要備忘錄或行事曆時，再連接對應來源。: Start with frequently used folders. Connect Notes or Calendar whenever you need them.
快速找檔名與影片: Find files and videos by name
選擇下載、文件、影片等常用位置。: Choose frequently used locations such as Downloads, Documents or Movies.
Han 自建本機索引，重新啟動也能接續搜尋。: Han builds its own local index so you can keep searching after a restart.
連接備忘錄與行事曆等來源: Connect Notes, Calendar and other sources
由你選擇要連接的 App，授權後可背景更新。: Choose which apps to connect. Authorized sources can update in the background.
可以稍後再設定：設定頁左下角有使用說明，「更新與關於」可重新開啟這份引導。: You can set these up later. Open the User Guide at the bottom left of settings, or replay this guide in Updates & About.
一個快捷鍵，回到手邊的事。: One shortcut. Back to your flow.
讓常用資料，也進得了搜尋。: Bring your everyday information into search.
少開幾個 App，多做一點事。: Open fewer apps. Get more done.
繁簡、檔名、文件裡的字，都從同一個搜尋框開始。: Chinese scripts, filenames and words inside documents—all from one search box.
選擇怎麼叫出 Han，以及下次開啟時要接續什麼。: Choose how to open Han and what to resume next time.
檔名與內文是兩種索引；都只讀取你主動選取的資料夾。: Filename and content search use separate indexes. Both read only the folders you choose.
想搜尋哪一類，就連接哪一類。其餘可以留到需要時。: Connect the sources you want to search. Leave the rest until you need them.
先看幾個實際輸入方式，之後就能直接在搜尋框使用。: Explore a few practical examples, then use them in the search box.
已設定的範圍立即生效；還沒連接的功能，之後隨時補上。: Your selected scopes take effect immediately. Connect other features whenever you like.
繁簡與 App 首字母，都能比對原始名稱。: Chinese scripts and app initials can match the original name.
以你習慣的字搜尋，不改動原始檔名與文字。: Search in your preferred script. Original names and text stay unchanged.
命中的字與內文片段會凸顯，方便判斷是不是要找的內容。: Highlighted words and excerpts help you recognize the right result.
App 可直接搜尋；文件內文與個人資料，需要先選範圍或連接來源。: App search works immediately. Choose folders or connect sources to search documents and personal information.
按一次開啟，再按一次收起。: Press once to open. Again to dismiss.
切換到其他 App 後，也用同一組快捷鍵叫出 Han。: Use the same shortcut after switching to another app.
可自訂組合，也可使用 ⌘Space。若原 Spotlight 仍占用，設定會提示: Choose your own shortcut or use ⌘Space. If Spotlight still uses it, settings will explain the conflict and link to macOS settings.
預設保留 3 分鐘。從收起開始計時，只在下次開啟時判斷，不會打斷正在輸入的內容。: The default is 3 minutes from dismissal. Expiry is checked when reopening, never while you type.
找名稱與路徑，不讀取影片內容。適合先加入下載、文件、影片等常用位置。: Find names and paths without reading video contents. Start with Downloads, Documents or Movies.
讀取 Word、文字 PDF、PPTX、XLSX 與文字文件。搜尋時會顯示命中的: Read Word, text PDF, PPTX, XLSX and text documents. Results show matching excerpts.
首次索引可能較久；完成後會保存在本機，背景只重新讀取有變動的文件。: The first index may take longer. It stays on your Mac, and background updates reuse unchanged documents.
預設不掃描整台 Mac；只讀取已選且可存取的範圍。檔名與內文結果會合併到「全部」: Han does not scan your entire Mac by default. It reads selected, accessible folders. All combines filename and content results.
掃描 PDF 需要先做 OCR；舊版 PPT／XLS 可轉成 PPTX／XLSX: Scanned PDFs need OCR first. Convert older PPT/XLS files to PPTX/XLSX. Settings lists read failures and suggested remedies.
內文索引預設上限 500 MB，含擷取文字，僅存本機且未額外加密。移除索引不會刪: The local text index has a 500 MB default limit and no additional encryption. Removing it does not delete original documents.
只有按下「連接」才會要求對應權限。授權有效時，已連接來源可安靜背景更新。: Permission is requested only when you choose Connect. Authorized sources can update quietly in the background.
Mail、捷徑與系統時鐘，也能在設定中連接。: Mail, Shortcuts and Clock can also be connected in settings.
搜尋標題與可讀取的純文字內文；不讀取鎖定備忘錄。: Search titles and accessible plain text. Locked notes are excluded.
